scope: One revised tool-enabled A1 on the same402questions/99developmentcases; source libraries rebuilt from empty in the same case folds. No new model/history/control/heldout.
user_direction: Repair actual reflection input, constrain unsupported tool generalizations, withhold single-image chronology, and bind final answer letter to original option text. Publish first; confirmation required before running.

episode.non_CXR: No planner or medical tool call; keep question in402denominator.
episode.tool_input: Only explicitly selected current original image; no question/options/reference sent to medical tool.
episode.image_scope: All original question images retained in planner/final answer; captions supply modality only, their diagnostic text is never sent.
episode.error_policy: Malformed plan records error and final answers from originals with NO_EVIDENCE, no paid repair retry. Tool initialization failure or five consecutive unusable tool returns stops. Revised answer-contract errors are missing, never paid retry.
episode.weights: Existing local weights only; no downloads or new services.

cache.old_direct_answers: No old D/v1 actor predictions substituted for new source or target episodes.
cache.old_E3_medical_returns: No old E3 or v1 medical returns treated as fresh calls; only new-round image-only deduplication.
cache.same_round_image_only: Samecase/source_filename/tool/actualimagebytes deduplicated; raw invocation and cache receipt separate. No reissue of started_unknown. Source and target may reuse a label-free image-only tool result; no source reference/answer reaches tool cache.
cache.old_API_meta: Only exact complete payload equality permits cache reuse; old actor payloads differ and are not substituted.

source_evolution.feedback: All case predictions persisted before that case reference opens; explicitly map both old and correct letters to complete option texts.
source_evolution.steps: Source-only full feedback context in serialized action_input, then original planning/actions/projected observations/final reply; full raw returns included only after feedback release.
source_evolution.action_skill_guard: Only supported required tools actually attempted in source trajectory; no invented tool traces, no copied patient/figure/question/option content.
source_evolution.official_encode_review_utility_governanc: Unmodified official modules; existing local neural embedding/model transport adaptations retained.
source_evolution.target_gate: Both frozen source libraries nonempty, and each source fold has at least one usable real tool return. No quality bypass.

comparison.baseline: D295/402 primary; original tools-v1 A1=276/402 secondary bundled revision comparison; old S1/HS descriptive.
comparison.effect: All four revisions are bundled. Neither v2-v1 nor A1-D identifies pure memory gain; matched no-memory tool agent is an optional future experiment, not approved here.

accounting.technical_extra: Counted separately without a cumulative count ceiling; still at most one eligible technical retry per request.
accounting.warning: Latest user instruction removes cumulative request-count ceilings for tools-v2. Historical3879requests and old5000/5250policy remain recorded; new requests continue in the same counter with a scoped authorization override, no counter reset. Original cumulative200CNY bookkeeping authorization/cap and monetary reservation remain unchanged. Per-call retry/token limits remain. Actual Credits unknown.

execution.default: No execute flag = no model/key/tool initialization.

publication: Full actual requests/returns/originalimages/toolinputs/projectedandrawoutputs/skillwindows/usage/recovery and relative original cache references. Explicit allowlist; no weights, keys or account ledgers.

revisions.reflection: After every source case is fully predicted and feedback released, prepend a source-only action_input containing complete question/options, old letter/text/raw reply, correct letter/text, input bindings and projected+raw tool returns. The official formatter preserves this field; official modules remain unchanged. No reference reaches source actor or target.
revisions.rebuild: Do not import v1 skills/utility or source predictions. Rebuild both libraries from empty with corrected source episodes. Fixed original folds/window30/buffer20/governance2 remain.
revisions.capabilities: Explicit CXR-only and non-severity classifier contract. Optional0–2 tool calls. Official quality review unchanged; narrow deterministic backstop rejects recognized score-as-severity/CT/must-call rules and checks active merged content before retrieval. Does not certify medical semantics.
revisions.chronology: Raw report remains immutable. Actor receives static clauses only; temporal keyword clauses withheld. Original-image timepoints must be bound by the question; do not infer order from filenames or reports. Regex can over-withhold or miss paraphrases; actor instruction remains necessary.
revisions.answer: One JSON object answer/option_text/reason; exact option-text equality with the given letter. A mismatch/malformed response is preserved and scored as missing in402, no extra paid repair or silent correction. Reason semantics cannot be proved by string equality.
